items.title: Pirate Galleon Storm Scene DXF | CNC Laser & Plasma Wall Art
items.description: A dramatic full-sail pirate ship cutting through stormy waves — featuring the iconic Jolly Roger flag, billowing sails, and crashing ocean detail. This multi-layer vector is engineered for clean plasma and laser cuts, delivering stunning depth and shadow on metal or wood. Perfect for nautical wall murals, man-cave décor, and statement pieces.
